verdict.rationale: Moss does publish a v1 API reference covering actions like `createWebSource` and the multiplexed `/v1/manage` endpoint. Nothing in the evidence shows it is interactive or has runnable "try it" examples, and the OpenAPI/Swagger probes all returned 404, so there is no sign of a spec-driven explorer. A static reference is an adjacent feature, not the interactive, runnable one the story asks for.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
